description.zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
description.en: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Applications page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
description.en: The job ID. You can obtain the job ID on the Tasks page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
description.en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespaces page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
